Hi Alyssa — thanks for the heads up and for the clear windows. We can absolutely pivot. Two practical formats we recommend depending on how deep you want to go: 

1) 90-minute Technical Deep Dive (recommended as a compact replace-for-demo):
   - 60 min: architecture & integration walkthrough + Q&A
   - 30 min: focused discussion on your POC criteria (latency, data residency, dataset shape)
   - Follow-up: 60-minute office hours (opt-in) to walk engineers through sample payloads

2) Half-day scoping workshop (3–4 hours):
   - Multi-team, hands-on planning + breakout on integration tasks — better if you want to lock POC requirements live

Marissa (SE) will lead the technical portion; copying her to confirm capacity.

Proposed slots that match your 13:00–17:00 ET constraint:
- Thu Aug 11, 13:00–14:30 ET — 90-min deep dive
- Tue Aug 16, 14:00–17:00 ET — half-day workshop

If you confirm which format and which slot, we will: 1) send a calendar invite, 2) attach a short POC-prep checklist and agenda, and 3) record the session if you want. I've attached an initial agenda stub for the technical deep dive.

Also — quick ask: can you share a sanitized sample of the data shape (or a short example document) ahead of the call? That helps us tailor kernel/memory/quantization suggestions up front.

—Jonas
